name: CAD of RF and Microwave Circuits
description: Review of basic microwave theory: transmission lines and waveguides – concepts of characteristic impedance, reflection coefficient, standing and propagating waves, network analysis: s, Z and other multi-port parameters, impedance matching and tuning, planar transmission lines: quasi-static analysis, full wave analysis, discontinuities, equivalent circuits, simple printed couplers, filters, power dividers, simulation of structures on HFSS/CST/ADS.
